name: What's involved in a professional kitchen cabinet painting project?

mainEntity.name: What's involved in a professional kitchen cabinet painting project?

acceptedAnswer.text: A professional kitchen cabinet painting project typically begins with a consultation and quote. Following approval, our team prepares the work area by protecting countertops, floors, and appliances. Cabinets are degreased, cleaned, sanded, and primed to ensure optimal paint adhesion. We then apply multiple coats of high-quality, durable paint suitable for kitchen environments, allowing proper drying time between coats. Finally, hardware is reinstalled, and the work area is thoroughly cleaned, leaving you with freshly updated cabinets.
acceptedAnswer.description: A professional kitchen cabinet painting project involves consultation, preparation, cleaning, sanding, priming, multiple paint coats, and cleanup. This ensures a durable and high-quality finish for your cabinets.
